content:
maria-partnerships: quick sync: GCP marketplace IaC enablement. Deliverables = 1) terraform module, 2) reference architecture + k8s sample, 3) docs + tiny demo for listing. target: 10 working days.

dan-cloud: assigning tom-terraform to the module. tom can you own module + CI?

tom-terraform: yep, I got this. plan: single-region (us-west1) with a `private_vpc` toggle. CI will run fmt, validate, and plan-diff on PRs.

emma-devex: I'll draft quickstart and marketplace listing copy. need a 1-min deploy video — who can record a clean run for the demo?

luca-arch: I'll produce the ref-arch diagram. will annotate: VPC peering for Private, routes for Dedicated pools, KV/cache colocated with inference nodes, and autoscaling policy suggestions.

partner-gcp-biz: marketing: we need a listing-ready diagram + short copy for approval. legal will want the dataflow before external review.

nina-legal: please include a dataflow diagram that highlights telemetry paths and PII boundaries. I can review within 48h after upload.

ci-bot: pipeline queued: `marketplace-gcp/ci/validate` (run id: 4521).

tom-terraform: starter module snippet for the README (use this as the consumption example):

```terraform
module "redwood_marketplace_gcp" {
  source       = "git::https://github.com/redwood/marketplace-iac.git//modules/gcp_marketplace?ref=v1.0.0"
  project      = var.project_id
  region       = var.region
  private_vpc  = var.private_vpc
  machine_type = var.machine_type
}
```

emma-devex: please add outputs example in README (lb_ip, instance_group_name, service_account_email). I'll mock screenshots for the listing.

luca-arch: ops/hardware note: recommend Ampere-compatible machine types for quantized 8-bit models; include a node-pool example with taints/labels so inference pods land on dedicated nodes.

tom-terraform: adding a `variables.tf` example and an optional `terragrunt.hcl` consumer snippet. will include `outputs.tf` with `lb_ip` and `sa_email`.

maria-partnerships: timeline: module PR in 5 days (day 5), docs + demo in 9 days. partner needs draft by day 6 for GCP review. next check-in in 48h. blockers?

partner-gcp-biz: blocker: listing review window opens day 7, so we need the draft earlier if possible.

nina-legal: reminder: include log retention and telemetry destinations in docs. we cannot send customer logs to third-party analytics without consent.

maria-partnerships: noted. tagging @tom-terraform @emma-devex @luca-arch. thanks all — I'll circulate calendar invite for the 48h touchpoint. :rocket:
